notes:
What's new in 0.39
• Hard bots are tougher: they throw bombs at you with the glove, kick bombs into your path and cut off your escape.
• Smarter bots at every level: they dodge new bombs faster and trap themselves less. Easy bots now fight back a little.
• When you're out against bots, the rest of the round fast-forwards (x4).
• Glove throws over the arena edge now fly across properly and land in the right spot.
• Player cards stay compact when you collect lots of power-ups, so they no longer cover the arena.
• Update check is faster and more reliable, with a retry button if it fails.
